nodes.label: W — the frontier width on which the g-condition holds
nodes.rationale: At each Z the walk needs only that among admissible channels the nu-minimiser is the sigma-minimiser; it does not need the whole ladder ordered. W is the smallest width at which the condition holds at all 107 rows and fails at w+1 somewhere — route (b)'s shape (a property with a bound) reached through route (c)'s field.

nodes.label: F83.1 — the population fault registered against the author
nodes.rationale: gtest83 scored the FULL candidate ladder when clause 2 had already ruled that out of scope: the derivation governs the DIFFERENTIATING ELECTRON, not the total configuration. So the 43 rows are not 43 failures of the derivation, and P2/P4's bands were filed against the wrong population — scored as filed, but declared UNINFORMATIVE.

nodes.label: Timing flag: route (c) numbers seen before filing
nodes.rationale: 43 within-failures, 11 across-failures (a subset), spanning Z=12..90 were known at filing; every band below is filed on the frontier width, a quantity not yet computed, and the clauses are written so the seen numbers do not determine them.

nodes.label: W = 2 would derive nothing
nodes.rationale: At w = 2 the statement reduces to 'rank 1 beats rank 2', which is the row's own criterion restated; W >= 3 is what would make the frontier a real property of the field.
